elements.text:
You post something different from what you normally post. After a couple of hours, you only have about half the number of likes on your post compared to what you normally have. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: People think my post is dumb.
My followers may be waiting to see what I post next.
People must not be online right now.
Others may not like my new post, but I do and that's what counts.
Even if no one likes what I posted, I do, and that's what's important.
